lede: The most consequential meeting this week is the Gondola Leadership Committee on July 28, where a Capital Investment Grant program, its funding commitments, and a project update are all on the table — with at least one item flagged as an action item, meaning decisions could actually get made. Town Council also convenes Monday as the Liquor Licensing Authority for a public hearing on KOTO Radio's Live at the Drive permit for July 30 at 207 N Pine Street. On the community side, it's a full week in the valley — Shakespeare in the park, The Music Man at the Sheridan, Box Canyon Races, and both farmers markets running through the weekend.
